headlines.text: Rewind to 2021, when it was title-change night for the AEW TNT Title as Cody Rhodes vs. Sammy Guevara battled it out, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.34 ? a well-worked match ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. A historic Christmas night title change ? Cody became the first three-time champion of any AEW title, surviving Guevara's GTH and a springboard 450 before finishing with back-to-back Cross Rhodes and a Tiger Driver, all while the legendary David Crockett presented the belt.

Looking back to 2025, when Bandido reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing Bandido vs. Ricochet on Dynamite, rated 7.25 ? a good, competitive contest in a hard-fought men's division clash ? part of that year's Dynamite On 34th Street '25.

Back on this day in 2025, Jack Perry vs. PAC met in a Continental Classic League Match, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.14 ? a well-worked match ? part of that year's Dynamite On 34th Street '25.
